name: K4-free graphs without independent 5-sets (rediscovering R(4,5) = 25)
description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'edges': [[u, v], ...]}: a simple graph on vertices 0..n-1 with 1 <= n <= 25. It must contain no K4 and no independent set of 5 vertices, checked exactly. Maximize n; the proven optimum is 24. Finding a 24-vertex (4,5)-graph recovers Kalbfleisch's lower bound; no 25-vertex graph exists.
